none: PAS NLM-E92F8F: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-337), Constantinopolis commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Constantinopolis helmeted left with sceptre. Obverse inscription: [CONSTANTINOPOLIS]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left on prow with shield and spear. In exergue: possibly TRS. Diameter: 15.5mm, Weight: 1.53gms, die axis: 6
